I've heard a lot of various groups on all sides use this statement when referring to a group of people they don't particularly like:

"If ten percent of a bowl of M&Ms were poisoned, would you eat them?"

Intuitively, this seems acceptable. Why would you even risk eating one M&M if you stand a significant chance of being made ill or killed? Why is this statement fallacious when referring to groups of people?
ELI5: Why is the 'poisoned M&Ms' meme fallacious?

It's saying "we should throw the baby out with the bathwater."

The analogy is a poor one, regardless. M&Ms are a manufactured product. You can test that 10% of a sample are poisoned, you can expect similar poison distribution throughout the batch.

People are not uniform in ideology. They have varying motives and perspectives.

A basic human right is to be treated as an individual; not judged because you have arbitrary similarities to someone else's enemies.

A basic human right is to be treated as an individual; not judged because you have arbitrary similarities to someone else's enemies.

If only more people understood this... what a great world this would be.
This analogy can be used for any group of people everywhere, if only one person of them has done some harm .
Just imagine a world where all food is possibly poisoned M&M's. Everyone is potentially dangerous.

If ten percent of a bowl of M&Ms were poisoned, would you eat them?

I would eat every single one just to make sure I died.

Formally speaking, I think the "poisoned M&Ms" meme primarily is a fallacy of composition, that is, one M&M being poisonous does not mean that all of them are poisonous. It's also a false equivalence because humans and M&Ms just so happen to have very little in common. Saying that humans are "poisonous" by nature would also deny them any form of free will.

However, I find it infinitely easier to point out how stupid this argument is by applying it to the people who use it, because literally every subgroup in human society has at least one bad apple. By their own logic, those who support the M&M meme thus necessarily are dangerous individuals themselves.
